description: The file implements classes and functions to manage Electron applications within Playwright, including launching Electron apps, managing application windows, and evaluating scripts.

classes.name: Electron
classes.description: Represents the Electron channel interface, providing methods to launch Electron applications.

classes.name: ElectronApplication
classes.description: Represents a running Electron application within Playwright, providing methods to interact with app windows, evaluate scripts, and manage application lifecycle.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches a new Electron application with specified options.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static method to get an Electron instance from a channel object.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specific event on the Electron application.

methods.name: firstWindow
methods.description: Returns the first window (Page) of the Electron application.

methods.name: windows
methods.description: Returns all open windows (Pages) of the Electron application.

methods.name: context
methods.description: Returns the BrowserContext associated with the Electron application.

methods.name: browserWindow
methods.description: Returns a JSHandle to the Electron BrowserWindow object of a specific page.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a function in the context of the Electron application.

methods.name: evaluateHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a function and returns a handle to the result.
